summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. All 24 RAW files map one-to-one to Sample.information.xlsx rows (Sample.ID, mammographic appearance, ER/PgR/IntClust exactly reproduced); technical values are supported by the paper Methods for sample sets 1 and 2; all controlled terms resolve. Only minor provenance and documentation issues remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh adversarial reviewer agent without producer transcript; evidence restricted to scratchpad/PXD021394/

spec_compliance.evidence: Column order and forms match `sdrf-tools contract -t ms-proteomics -t human -t clinical-metadata -t oncology-metadata`; required columns (organism, organism part, biological replicate, age, sex, assay name, technology type, technical replicate, data file, acquisition method, instrument, cleavage agent, label, fraction identifier) present; reserved words used only where permitted (age/sex/cell type 'not available'; PgR 'not available' inside free-text clinical data); source name and assay name unique; 24 rows x 35 columns; repeated sdrf template/modification columns are legal 'multiple' columns. Bare 'label free sample' matches spec README usage. dia-acquisition template omission verified as defensible: its YAML (sdrf_pipelines dia-acquisition/1.1.0) enforces the bare literal 'Data-independent acquisition'.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved one parquet at a time from sdrf-pipelines cache: MS:1002877 q exactive hf-x; MS:1001251 trypsin; MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation (spec-canonical HCD); PRIDE:0000450 data-independent acquisition; PRIDE:0000608 dithiothreitol (DTT); PRIDE:0000599 iodoacetamide (IAA); UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:1 Acetyl; 'breast' = UBERON:0000310; 'breast cancer' = MONDO:0007254 / DOID:1612; 'label free sample' = MS:1002038. Phenotype values are free text (permitted: PATO, EFO, free text); no PATO/EFO term for spiculated appearance exists in cache. sdrf-tools check --offline CLEAN (0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps).

source_evidence.evidence: Sample.information.xlsx (deposited, 24 rows) reproduced exactly per row for source name, individual, phenotype/factor, and 'ER x; PgR y; IntClust z' (V20/V21 PgR blank -> 'not available'). Type.of.tissue = Breast primary tumor for all 24 supports organism part/disease/material type. Manuscript: 'For downstream DIA MS analysis (sample sets 1 and 2)... digested as previously mentioned' (FASP, 100 mM DTT, 50 mM iodoacetamide, trypsin 1:50), unfractionated; 'For DIA MS analysis (sample sets 1 and 2), a Q-Exactive HF-X'; 'fragmented by HCD (collision energy: 30)'. Modifications: MaxQuant Cys carbamidomethyl fixed, N-terminal acetyl and Met oxidation variable; Comet library search 'parameter sets were similar to those of MaxQuant'. Sex 'not available' verified: 'collected from women' is in the set-1 (21 specimens, 172-sample cohort) paragraph; the set-2 paragraph (24 tumours from 109-sample cohort) states no sex/age. PRIDE instrument 'Q Exactive' (MS:1001911) is a generic record entry superseded by the paper's explicit HF-X.

file_mapping.evidence: files_raw_names.json lists 24 RAW files; SDRF comment[data file] contains exactly these 24, no duplicates, no non-raw files; assay name = file stem on every row. Non-raw deposits (2 FASTA, PQP library, feature_alignment_matrix.tsv, Sample.information.xlsx) correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: 24 distinct tumours/individuals, one DIA run each: biological replicate 1, technical replicate 1, fraction identifier 1 (unfractionated DIA per Methods). Factor value[phenotype] equals characteristics[phenotype] on every row; recomputed groups spiculated 4 (V03, V12, V15, V18), non-spiculated 20, matching the sheet and the report. ER/PgR/IntClust carried as covariates, not factors.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value traced to the deposited sheet, PRIDE record, or manuscript Methods. No unsupported specificity: sex/age/cell type left 'not available' rather than inferred 'female' from the generic breast-cancer context; no per-sample values derived from cohort summaries; collision energy unit NCE is the standard Q Exactive HCD convention for 'collision energy: 30'. Omitted recommended columns (precursor/fragment mass tolerance, ancestry category) have no DIA-specific evidence and their omission does not assert anything false.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock /tmp/sdrf_validate.lock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t clinical-metadata -t oncology-metadata --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0, only 2 warnings (free-text phenotype not in pato;efo). sdrf-tools structure: OK (exit 0). sdrf-tools check --offline: CLEAN (exit 0). sdrf-tools score: 95/100. sdrf-tools reconcile --record pride.json: exit 1 with one flag 'cleavage_agent_unsupported' (PRIDE record never names trypsin) - adjudicated false positive: manuscript Methods state trypsin digestion (1:50, 37 C, 16 h) explicitly for DIA sample sets 1 and 2.

findings.message: Report says remaining sdrf-tools reconcile flags are 'explained below', but the cleavage_agent_unsupported flag (trypsin absent from PRIDE record) is never explained.
findings.evidence: reconcile exit 1 with that single flag; manuscript 'Proteins were then digested with trypsin (enzyme:protein ratio of 1:50)' resolves it. Correction: add one line citing the Methods sentence.
